_comment: PINNED Phase-0 Buzz relay wire contract. This is the shape the closed relay validates against BEFORE membership: the NIP-42 AUTH event kind, the NIP-29 channel-message kind the subscription REQ asks for, and the exact tag names the AUTH event must carry. The sidecar's live constants are checked against this fixture at build/boot by compat-check.ts, which WARNS (never fails) on drift so a relay upgrade that moves a kind or renames a tag surfaces loudly instead of silently breaking AUTH in production. The `digest` is a sha256 over the canonical (sorted-key) JSON of the contract fields below it and is what compat-check recomputes; a digest mismatch means SOME field drifted even if a hand-diff missed it. Regenerate with compat-check.computeContractDigest() when a relay contract change is intentional.
